title: Compose QQ16 protected returns across installed callers
body:
Installing #4167's protected-return exchange directly into #4166 leaves the Installation's cached native inventory stale: the unchanged integrated fixture reaches four producer returns, then fails the original disjointness guard. This package composes that existing exchange across both actual producer and decoder-service callers, updates both ownership caches, and preserves the original guards and controlled cleanup.

The new opt-in D* preserves frozen D's successful behavior under a finite physical-role permutation. The inherited complete source census includes all 510678Γ producer and 336Γ service calls, including the later root suffix. With complete returned packet volume v, the exact matched read/write/unit-move saving is:

```
D − D* = 511014Γ (5v+2, 2v, 4v+2).
```

The per-return transaction and tariff are credited to #4167; the caller, census and publication protocol are credited to #4166. The new result is their safe installed composition and whole-root matched protocol difference. Finite validation, compilation and rebinding control is explicitly charged as an unknown signed Δ_control. This is not a full D* versus B* win, a production O73 execution, supplier admission or a κ improvement.

Validation:

- The unchanged reduced integrated fixture runs two nonconstant generations in both arms: 24 real child calls, 4 producer → 6 service → 2 later producer per generation. Full endpoints agree; all record-Tape meters differ by exactly `(61488,24576,49200)`, matching the individual returns. This is reduced-geometry execution, not production all-engine metering.
- Controls reach the original stale-engine guard, reject stale external bindings and output aliasing, and verify actual controlled disposal after an adopted service return before fixture cleanup.
- Registered normal and `-O` checks pass. All 136 live inputs authenticate, the original source checks remain enabled, and only the historical selected record is restored inside a disposable projection.
- Committed-byte/source-history preflight and official 143-file export check pass. Git-free normal/optimized cold replay preserves all exported bytes. Corrupt-source and boolean-to-integer receipt controls reject as expected.

[Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4744#discussioncomment-19131467). The package retains predecessor attribution and explicit open questions. Local validation is complete; hosted CI has not been verified. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
